Favite.why: AOI inspection and metrology equipment maker moving from display into 2.5D/3D advanced packaging: die-location / overlay metrology and fine-line RDL inspection for wafer- and panel-level (FOPLP) packaging; its tools gain as AI-chip packaging capacity expands.
Favite.evidence: Favite 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026), letter to shareholders: R&D focused on 2.5D/3D advanced-packaging inspection and Die Location / Overlay / 3D metrology; its 12-inch wafer-level inspection system has been adopted by a flagship customer and die-location metrology is in verification with substrate and packaging customers.

players.product: AOI inspection and die-location / overlay metrology tools for wafer- and panel-level (FOPLP) 2.5D/3D advanced packaging and fine-line RDL
